title: Appealing an infraction

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello, 

After reviewing your infractions, I've decided to deny your appeal. Mainly because your appeal lacks detail, plus you've been punished recently. As of now, I recommend waiting 2-3 months, and sending in a detailed appeal explaining why we should unban you.

Best Regards, 
Zeusy,
Avicus Senior Moderator
